This article compares the performance of Danish regions and child and adolescent psychiatric clinics on Indicator 2b, which measures the proportion of ADHD assessment processes for 6-17-year-olds that include a manualized diagnostic interview or environmental observation within 120 days of the assessment's start [^src1]. The national standard requires a compliance rate of at least 90% [^src1].

For the 2023/24 reporting period, the data reveals a widespread failure to meet this target, characterized by severe regional inequalities [^src1]. Only one clinic, [[odense-borne-og-ungdomspsykiatrisk-ambulatorium|Odense: Børne- og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Ambulatorium]], successfully met the standard, achieving a 98% compliance rate [^src1]. Every other region and clinic missed the target [^src1]. At the regional level, [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] was the highest performer at 77%, while [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]], [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]], and [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] tied for the lowest regional performance at just 31% [^src1]. Among the specific clinics listed, [[aabenna-borne-og-ungdomspsykiatrisk-ambulatorium|Aabenraa: Børne og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Ambulatorium]] scored 89%, falling just short of the target, whereas [[bua-smaborn-klinik|BUA Psykiatrisk Klinik for Småbørn]] and [[vejle-bup-ambulatorium|Vejle: Børne- Og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Ambulatorium]] scored 75% and 58%, respectively [^src1]. The national average for Denmark stood at 48% [^src1].

Analyzing the trends across the 2021/22, 2022/23, and 2023/24 periods shows significant volatility in most regions, contrasted by Odense's remarkable stability [^src1]. Nationally, compliance dipped from 49% in 2021/22 to 43% in 2022/23, before recovering slightly to 48% in 2023/24 [^src1]. [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]] experienced a steady and severe decline, dropping from 59% to 43%, and finally to 31% [^src1]. [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]] followed a similar dip-and-recover pattern, falling from 52% to 40% before rising to 46% [^src1]. [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] also dipped to a low of 17% in 2022/23 before rebounding to 31% [^src1]. Conversely, [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] saw a sharp increase to 90% in 2022/23 before dropping back to 77% in the most recent period [^src1].

Odense stands out as a massive outlier in this dataset [^src1]. While the rest of the country struggled to keep half of its assessments within the 120-day framework, Odense maintained near-perfect compliance, scoring 99% in both 2021/22 and 2022/23, and 98% in 2023/24 [^src1].
